A new chapter
starts with you

A speaker, moderator, and award-winning podcast host who brings lived experience to conversations about change.

COACH DÉA’s work is personal. As a mother of five, a Brazilian-born adoptee, and a woman who has navigated divorce, she brings lived experience to conversations about change.

Her speaking draws on women’s empowerment, marriage, family, and relationships. Her own journey is rooted in faith, and her door is open to people of every background, with faith or without.

Read COACH DÉA’s story

Adopted alongside her fraternal twin in Brazil, COACH DÉA is now a mother of five and a grandmother. Divorce, faith, and rebuilding her own life shape the way she connects with others.

Dance scholarships at the Joffrey Ballet and Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater brought her to the United States. Her creative path continued through singing, songwriting, entrepreneurship, and podcasting.

Training & experience

  • Marriage and family coaching, and divorced women’s coaching — Light University / American Association of Christian Counselors.
  • Certified Trauma Healing Facilitator — Trauma Healing Institute.

Her Mama Taco Towel invention received a Huggies MomInspired grant. Her charitable work in Uganda earned the President’s Call to Service Award.

Before the
conversation

What does COACH DÉA speak about?

Her work centers on women’s empowerment, relationships, self-discovery, and life’s new chapters. Her experience as a Certified Trauma Healing Facilitator and her own journey of faith also inform her perspective. Share your audience and goals to discuss the right focus.

Can COACH DÉA moderate our conversation?

Yes. COACH DÉA is a speaker and moderator, and hosts Love Most, The Podcast with COACH DÉA. Use the enquiry form to describe the conversation, participants, and format you have in mind.

Does the audience need to share her faith?

No. Faith is part of COACH DÉA’s personal story, and she welcomes people of all backgrounds, including those with no religious faith. Include any relevant audience context in your event enquiry.

How do we enquire about an engagement?

Send your event date, location or online format, audience, and proposed topic through the enquiry form. It prepares an email to COACH DÉA so you can discuss availability, fit, and arrangements directly.
